bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
name=deploy-gaybbs-1
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name")" = true
docker exec "$name" sh -lc 'grep -Fq "startPayload===\"link\"" /app/gaybbs.mjs && echo LINK_START_HANDLER=PASS || echo LINK_START_HANDLER=NOT_FOUND'
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT chat_id||'|'||message_thread_id||'|'||state||'|'||coalesce(message_id::text,'NULL')||'|'||revision FROM board_menu_panels WHERE panel_type='posting' ORDER BY chat_id,message_thread_id;" | sed -E 's/(-?[0-9]+)\|([0-9]+)\|/GROUP=\1 THREAD=\2 STATE=/'
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT feature||'='||CASE WHEN enabled THEN 'ON' ELSE 'OFF' END FROM gaybbs_feature_release_gates WHERE feature='link';"
echo TELEGRAM_BUTTON_PRESS=NOT_VERIFIED
